lines: Rahul Bahri (Investor Selling Shareholder) may sell up to 1,800 shares in the offer for sale, with proceeds of up to ₹0.24 crore if all offered shares are sold, before offer expenses and taxes.
The timing is at listing, with trading start printed as March 11, 2026, which makes a call timely now.
His estimated retained stake is ₹0.57 crore at offer price, and the gain is up to ₹0.18 crore.
Confidence is medium: the name is verified in the seller table, but holdings appear in one section only (promoter_holding).
